AT&T Phone – Advanced | AT&T Home Phone

New AT&T Phone – Advanced

Keep your number.
Keep your home phone.
Stay connected.

AT&T Phone – Advanced uses the latest technology to support your current phone. It works seamlessly with up to six devices, and includes all the popular features you know and love.

Excludes rotary/pulse phones.
Call 888.256.1561
Packed with features
Keep your current home phone
Local and long-distance voice calling
Voicemail 
Online management of features 
Call Forwarding, Caller ID, and Call Waiting
Digital Phone Call Protect*
E911 location detection with 24-hour automatic battery backup**
3-way calling and anonymous call blocking
*Service may inadvertently block or misidentify wanted calls and service messages as spam. For more details go to www.att.com/phonecallprotect. **AT&T Phone – Advanced is powered by electricity in your home. The battery backup provided by AT&T will not power any devices connected to the AT&T Phone – Advanced equipment. AT&T recommends an alternative battery power source for those devices. If you’re using a cordless phone with your AT&T Phone – Advanced service, a separate battery backup or other power source may be required to place calls, including 911, if there is a power outage. See http://www.att.com/batterybackup for details.
Call 888.256.1561
A new way to stay connected

See how AT&T Phone – Advanced delivers crystal clear calling to your home.

AT&T Phone – Advanced

How does it work?

Instead of traditional wired phone lines, AT&T Phone – Advanced uses the AT&T cellular network and/or a broadband connection to provide your home telephone service. Once everything is set up, it works just like your traditional phone does now. Most importantly, you’ll enjoy a crystal-clear, reliable connection.

Call 888.256.1561
Get your equipment for $1—a $188 value savings.* Plus free shipping.
*Taxes extra. $1 equipment charge offer subject to change and may be discontinued at any time.
We make it easy to get set up

Professional installation

We’ll get you started

Once you receive your device, you can schedule an appointment for an AT&T technician to visit your home to set it up for an additional charge. They’ll also help set up your previously connected devices.

Self-install

Do it yourself

Your AT&T Phone – Advanced device will come with everything you need to set up and get connected. Colored stickers label each component and match each step in the installation guide for hassle-free setup.

Two ways to keep you connected
Cellular connection

AT&T Phone – Advanced uses the AT&T cellular network to provide voice service. There’s no separate charge for this connectivity. Just be sure to place your device on the first or second floor near a window or outside wall.

Home broadband connection

AT&T Phone – Advanced works with most broadband connection. You’ll simply use your current modem. If the AT&T cellular network connection is unavailable, you’ll stay connected via broadband.  Just be sure the device is located in a convenient location (not in a closet, basement, or other hard-to-reach-location).
